subject.title: fix(agents): reject invalid bundled LSP framing

question: Should bundled LSP sessions enforce 8 KiB header and 64 MiB body limits as fatal compatibility boundaries?
rationale: Bounds are necessary to prevent retained-buffer growth, but the LSP specification does not define maxima and exceeding either threshold terminates the server and all of its tools.

options.title: Adopt current limits
options.body: Keep 8 KiB headers and 64 MiB bodies, fix malformed-line validation, and lock both boundaries with focused compatibility tests.

options.title: Recalibrate limits
options.body: Choose different thresholds and update boundary plus representative-language-server proof before merge.

options.title: Defer bounded framing
options.body: Pause this PR and keep the canonical issue open until maintainers select a different safety policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt current limits
recommendation.body: Keep 8 KiB headers and 64 MiB bodies, fix malformed-line validation, and lock both boundaries with focused compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: She is the currently assigned reviewer and best available owner to confirm or route the threshold decision with the feature-history contributors.
